Services / Webflow development

FIGMA TO WEBFLOW

Your approved design. A carefully built Webflow site.

Turn a supplied Figma design into responsive Webflow pages, with reusable components and attention to the details that are easy to lose in the handoff.

Discuss this project →See starting prices

When it fits

For designers, agencies and teams with an approved visual direction who need a development partner. Before the build, I review the file, responsive states and functionality so gaps can be resolved early.

What is included

  • Design-file and functionality review
  • Responsive page implementation in Webflow
  • Reusable components and consistent styles
  • Interaction, link and responsive checks

What I need from you

  • The approved Figma file and relevant breakpoints
  • Fonts, copy and image assets you can use
  • CMS, forms and integration requirements

A clear scope from the beginning.

New visual directions, missing page designs and complex integrations are scoped separately when they are not covered by the supplied design.

How we work

Review

We agree on the goal, content and functionality.

Define

The proposal sets out pages, deliverables and reviews.

Implement

Development, checks and a handover with clear next steps.

What if my file only includes desktop layouts?

We can plan the smaller-screen layouts, but that work needs to be defined before development rather than left to assumptions.
